start.note: Over the whole parcel just after budbreak, the shoots a hand long, the panel on its Scene section.

steps.note: A slow orbit under the season and layout edits.
The season's shoots grow up through the catch wires.

Down to the outer row from outside it, uphill. With the rows at 25 degrees and 1.8 m apart, Row_000 is the outermost, 12 m long in the parcel's corner around (28.6, -16.5); yaw 25 looks square across it, and nothing is planted on the camera's side.
Trained low, as in a cool climate: the posts come down with the heads.
Stray shoots lean out of the canopy toward the camera, up to 0.9 m out of the row.
In on Row_000/Vine_004/Shoot_04_0/Leaf_02, a blade on the row's outer face 0.7 m up, facing out and up; the camera is about 0.4 m outside it, where the canopy reaches 0.3 m out.
Down and back to the trunk of Row_000/Vine_004, shaded on the way.
An old vine: a thicker trunk, its bark ridged deeper.
One cordon to a vine, reaching the whole way to the next.
Winter: the canopy drops to last season's bare canes.
Up and back from the row first, on its outer side, so the move over the parcel starts above every canopy.
Out to the whole winter vineyard, centred beside the panel.
